title: FICTIONAL EXAMPLE — Psychological Safety and Team Learning in Distributed Teams: A Systematic Review
abstract: Replace this with the manuscript abstract. (This is a synthetic placeholder, not a real submission.) The abstract is used only for the best-effort self-match lookup; the matching itself is driven by the tiered terms below.
_comment_terms: Sort the manuscript's keywords into tiers by how DISTINCTIVE each is to this paper. core = its defining subject (weighted x3). secondary = related constructs it touches (x1). method_primary = its actual method, e.g. bibliometrics/meta-analysis (x2). method_generic = common methods that are weak discriminators, e.g. literature review (x0.8). context = setting (x0.4). A term earns credit only when it actually appears in a candidate's title/abstract.
_comment_scope: disciplines: optional subset of the journal registry to search (omit for ALL). Run `python -m reviewer_id --list-disciplines` to see options. journals: optional explicit list of journal names/ids to restrict to.
_comment_confidential: confidential (default true): send OpenAlex ONLY generic topic terms — never the title, abstract, your email, or author-institution names; no AI/LLM ever sees the manuscript. Set false only for already-published work (enables the title self-match lookup). CLI --confidential / --no-confidential overrides this.
_comment_coi: author_institutions: the submitting authors' institutions — any candidate affiliated with one is excluded (in confidential mode matched LOCALLY, so give full names). This is also the no-names way to drop the authors themselves. author_orcids: optional ORCID iDs (not names) of the submitting authors — enables excluding the authors AND their recent co-authors; opt-in in confidential mode via screen_coauthors because it transmits the ORCIDs.
_comment_ledger: reviewer_ledger: optional path to a local CSV of reviewers to skip (recently invited / declined / ineligible in your system). Auto-uses reviewer-ledger.csv if present. ledger_cooldown_months: dated entries become eligible again after this many months. CLI: --ledger PATH / --no-ledger / --ledger-cooldown N. Local & confidential — never transmitted.
_comment_filters: Freshness filters (defaults shown; set either to 0 to disable, or override per-run with CLI --active-within-years / --max-related-age). active_within_years: drop a candidate with no publication in the last N years (inactive / likely nonresponsive). max_related_paper_age: drop a candidate whose most recent MATCHING paper is older than N years (stale on-topic expertise).
_comment_panel: Optional scorecard the suggested panel tries to satisfy (defaults shown). Boxes the pool can't fill are reported, not silently dropped. Override any subset.
